components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-emphasis local action such as Add quest or Run report.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(28% 0.08 265); color: oklch(99% 0.006 245); padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(25% 0.04 260 / 0.08); transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(34% 0.1 265); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(74% 0.12 230); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card Surface
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.03 255); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(99% 0.006 245); color: oklch(20% 0.018 255); padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(25% 0.04 260 / 0.08); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 16px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(50% 0.055 260); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input, select, and textarea surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(34% 0.07 260); } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.03 255); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(99% 0.006 245); color: oklch(20% 0.018 255); padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: oklch(67% 0.14 230); outline: 2px solid oklch(74% 0.12 230 / 0.28); outline-offset: 0; }

narrative.overview: Project Hub is a quiet, dense product interface for one developer managing local projects. It should feel structured, inspectable, and ready for repeated daily use.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained slate-tinted neutrals with one deep blue-slate primary action color.
Dense but readable product typography using Inter and system fallbacks.
8px-radius controls and cards, with subtle borders and low shadows.

rules.name: The Local Truth Rule
rules.body: Color must clarify state, selection, or action priority. It should not decorate maintenance data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not stack heavy shadows on ordinary cards. Use border, ring, and background tone first.

dos: Do keep the current quest, dependency health, or maintenance summary visible above detailed lists.
Do use concrete local truth: paths, commands, report timestamps, git hashes, and warnings.
Do use OKLCH values for new hand-authored color values.
donts: Don't bury local developer actions behind ornamental UI.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, side-stripe accents, or repeated icon-card grids as default patterns.
